field.label: Daily check
field.help: Check for new firmware every night. New versions are announced in the system status.

field.label: GitHub repository
field.help: Repository whose releases contain the firmware builds (owner/name).

field.label: Access token
field.help: Only for a private repository: fine-grained token with read-only access to its contents.

field.label: Firmware variant
field.help: Must match the firmware currently installed. Changing variant is not supported from here.

field.label: Pre-releases
field.help: Also offer builds of unreleased Dasharo branches. Not validated by 3mdeb.
